csvDelimiter.description: CSV field delimiter; UTF-8, CRLF and formula escaping remain mandatory.

csvIncludeBom.description: Include a UTF-8 byte-order mark at the start of CSV when true; false omits it. Default: no BOM. Only valid with CSV selected; UTF-8, CRLF and formula protection remain mandatory.

xlsxSheetName.description: XLSX base worksheet name: ASCII letters/digits, spaces, periods, underscores and hyphens; start alphanumeric, no trailing space, History reserved. Additional worksheets append numbered suffixes, shortening the base to fit 31 characters. Omit to preserve template/platform names.

ReportRequestV2.description: Explicit mappings. Optional outputs must be selected outputs, with at least one required output. Every output must have a mapping; each required output needs a required delivery. Required deliveries cannot depend on optional outputs. Duplicate destination/format pairs and physical targets are rejected. Backend enforces cross-field rules.

dataSourceRef.description: A JDBC reference captures current rows before each new job is accepted. Retries and reprocessing reuse the accepted immutable snapshot. Category is a bound value in the fixed deployment-owned sales adapter; no SQL, URLs or credentials are accepted.

assets.description: Omitted or null assets means no dependencies. Otherwise, complete exact dependency closure. Canonical base64 PNG/JRTX/JRXML/TTF files only; <=8192 bytes each, <=16384 bytes total, PNG dimensions <=512 each; at most eight image elements across the source closure and eight constant styles per style-dependent report. At most four detail-band or direct summary-section subreport elements per report, two dependency levels (child/grandchild), eight expanded elements along the graph; acyclic complete closure and matching immediate-parent parameters. Detail components receive the current row; summary components receive their immediate parent report's full accepted row collection. Each gets a fresh data cursor; custom bindings remain unsupported. TTF subsets: <=256 glyphs, unrestricted embedding flags, regular TrueType outlines; PDF embeds and HTML packages font bytes, XLSX/DOCX carry family hints. Missing rendered glyphs fail generation. Full JSON request <=65536 bytes.

jrxml.description: UTF-8 JasperReports 7 parent JRXML, maximum 32768 bytes. Full JSON request maximum 65536 bytes.

rows.description: Maximum 32768 canonical UTF-8 bytes; empty data is rejected. Values must have their declared JSON types.

mappingSha256.description: Content hash of deployment-owned identifiers; no endpoint, credentials or raw SQL. New imports retain their original mapping fingerprint.

importId.description: Immutable provenance import identifier; preserved by keyed retries.

mapping_sha256.description: Immutable fingerprint of the deployment table/column mapping used by this import.
